name: California Attorney-Client AI Redaction Policy
description: California-specific strict overlay extending the US baseline. California requires full anonymization — not mere tokenization — before inputting client matter information into external AI systems (Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 6068(e)(1), CA COPRAC Practical Guidance 2026). Key differences from US baseline: (1) case captions are blocked for human review rather than tokenized, because sending any token to an external AI risks re-identification; (2) contact details are elevated to critical — quasi-identifiers in combination can re-identify a client without names; (3) personal quasi-identifiers (DOB, age, gender) are added as they contribute to re-identification under CA's stricter standard; (4) the 2026 agentic AI guidance prohibits autonomous external transmission of confidential information — this policy enforces the hardest available gate on privilege markers.

rules.notes: CA SBN format rule — higher severity than the US base bar_number rule; SBN is a quasi-identifier under CA's full-anonymization standard
